name: Tumerok Treehouse
title: Tumerok Treehouse
summary: An Empyrean platform in the Tiofor Woods at 43.9N 10.8E, once the Banderling treehouse. A 15.6 m wooden staircase climbs to a plank platform at z 55, built into a giant Tall Tree (static 0x020003A1, 31 m crown, 62 m tall) that stands in a forest hollow at z 40. The chest and a gift box are up on the platform, and a low brick foundation, a barrel and a red-glowing frame lie at its foot. Pines 30-77 m tall ring the hollow. The landblocks east of x 27264 are missing from the kit.
